purpose: reader-facing explanation of the source-supported scholarship criteria and two-stage review workflow

required_facts.fact: The scholarship was intended for people with meaningful current work who wanted training to scale its impact, not general career exploration.
required_facts.evidence: Source line 34: purpose and scope are defined.

required_facts.fact: No prior AI experience was required, but the application needed a clear connection between current work and the timing of the Bootcamp.
required_facts.evidence: Source line 34: prior experience and relevance requirements are stated.

required_facts.fact: Generic or one-line responses and applications focused only on jobs, isolated tools, or short-term income were filtered early.
required_facts.evidence: Source line 39: early filtering criteria are listed.

required_facts.fact: A strong application described a specific problem, its beneficiaries, and why training mattered now.
required_facts.evidence: Source line 42: the three parts of a strong response are specified.

required_facts.fact: Reviewers considered whether applicants understood the Bootcamp and needed production-focused training to advance current work.
required_facts.evidence: Source line 45: alignment and production-training criteria are described.

required_facts.fact: Completion likelihood was assessed through project history, concrete plans, or accountability structures.
required_facts.evidence: Source line 48: follow-through signals are stated.

required_facts.fact: More than 2,500 applications made full manual review infeasible.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 6 and 54: application volume and manual-review constraint are given.

required_facts.fact: Claude Code used detailed custom slash commands for an AI-assisted preliminary ranking and filtering pass.
required_facts.evidence: Source line 56: evaluation logic, commands, ranking, and filtering are described.

required_facts.fact: Parallel sub-agents processed large batches, while reusable Markdown workflows avoided building a custom coded agent.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 59 and 64: parallel commands and command-based workflows are stated.

required_facts.fact: The top 50 were shuffled and manually checked, including full reading, profile or project checks, and comparison of AI scores with application substance.
required_facts.evidence: Source line 66: final review procedure and qualitative priorities are described.

author_attribution: Explain the historical process as Alexey documented it, retaining the distinction between automated filtering and personal final review.
